displayPattern: 7-segment display on a Trane S9V2 two-stage variable-speed furnace (Service Facts S9V2-SF-2A-EN): E3.3
meaning: 2nd stage pressure switch PS2 is closed when it should be open. The service facts say the pressure switch is not the problem in most cases.
causes: PS2 wiring or tube routing is not correct
PS2 is not oriented for the application
The switch itself, after the orientation and wiring checks
diySteps: Do not jumper PS2. The note on this chart says 24 volts across the switch means it is open, and 0 volts means it is closed

Technician: cycle power off and on, confirm PS2 orientation against the installer's guide, and measure across PS2 (brown to yellow). The chart says to replace the pressure switch when that voltage is not present, and to verify the wiring or replace the IFC when 24 volts is present
proAdvice: Call a licensed HVAC technician. E3.3 is PS2 stuck closed. E3.1 is the 1st stage switch. E3.4 is PS2 open when it should be closed.
safetyNote: If you smell gas, do not touch any electrical switch or use a phone in the building; leave immediately and call your gas supplier from outside. Turn off electrical power at the furnace switch or breaker before opening any panel, and never bypass or jumper a limit, rollout or pressure switch. Gas valve, burner, venting, wiring and control-board work should be done by a licensed HVAC technician.
